summary: KinetixUI 0.27.0 turns React's Rating into a real radio group, stops Metric's value and trend from colliding, and adds four rem-based responsive variants to the shared Tailwind preset. The fixed core cohort moves @kinetixui/ui, @kinetixui/tokens and @kinetixui/cli together on the 0.27.0 line. @kinetixui/angular publishes 0.26.2 on its own line, carrying the same Metric fix and a tokens peer range widened to >=0.24.0 <0.28.0; it remains Preview. @kinetixui/iot stays on 0.5.0.

changes.title: Rating is a radio group of real radios
changes.body: Rating declared role=radiogroup but held five independent aria-pressed buttons, so nothing was ever checked, no position was announced and it was five tab stops with no arrow keys. The stars are now native radio inputs in one group per instance, named "1 star" to "5 stars"; the roving tab stop, arrow movement, RTL mirroring and the "3 of 5" announcement come from the browser, and Home and End choose the first and last. readOnly is unchanged in appearance and is exposed as an image named "Rated 3 out of 5". No props changed. The markup inside the group changed from a button per star to a label with a visually hidden radio, so a stylesheet or test that targets `.rating button` may need to target the label or the star instead. Keyboard behaviour is verified through user-event's emulation of radio-group navigation, not a real browser.

changes.title: Metric's value and trend wrap instead of colliding
changes.body: The value and trend row now wraps rather than compressing: the figure is never broken mid-number, a trend too wide to sit beside the value moves to its own line, and the arrow and figure wrap last. In a browser the pair had overflowed its card by 14.1px at 1280px, and at 320px with 200% text two cards overlapped. After the change the sweep shows no overflow. MetricProps is unchanged; a data-kx-metric-pair marker is added as a measurement handle, not a styling hook.

changes.title: Four rem-based responsive variants in the Tailwind preset
changes.body: The preset exported as ./tailwind.config now registers sm-rem (40rem), md-rem (48rem), lg-rem (64rem) and xl-rem (80rem) as variants, so they follow the reader's text size. md-rem is new; the other three previously existed only in the website's own config, so a consumer's sm-rem: utility generated no rule. Nothing is removed or renamed and no existing utility changes the widths it applies at. They are variants rather than theme.screens entries because Tailwind 3.4 silently emits no min-* or max-* rules when screens mix units.

changes.title: kx-metric wraps, and the tokens peer range widens
changes.body: @kinetixui/angular 0.26.2 applies the same wrapping contract to .kx-metric using the existing spacing tokens; no selector or public class name changed. Its @kinetixui/tokens peer range is >=0.24.0 <0.28.0, so it keeps supporting tokens 0.24 to 0.27. The Angular change was verified by the package's stylesheet gates, not by a rendered Angular measurement. Angular remains Preview.

changes.title: Documentation site layout corrections
changes.body: The blocks gallery now takes its two-column step at 420px, which previously emitted no rule in the built site, and the homepage spotlight and preview toolbar spacing were corrected. These change the website only and are not published package API.

changes.title: Core moves together on the 0.27.0 release line
changes.body: @kinetixui/ui carries the changes. @kinetixui/tokens and @kinetixui/cli move with it because the three packages are one fixed Changesets cohort. Angular and IoT continue on their independent release lines.

limitations: Rating's keyboard behaviour is verified through user-event emulation, not a real browser keyboard session.
Angular remains Preview; this release does not graduate it, and its Metric fix was not measured in a rendered Angular browser.
SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose and Flutter remain source-checkout distributions rather than packages published to their platform registries.
IoT remains a React-only module. @kinetixui/iot is not published by this release.
